excerpt: The materials developed for the Sudan Evidence Base Programme use real-world examples, many of which are based on publicly available data at the time they were developed. These materials are free for public use and we encourage governments, universities, civil society organizations, media organizations, and individuals to download them, change them, and use them. Please note that some of the real-world figures and data may change, and so site users are encouraged to verify data accuracy before using data from the site. The World Bank Group and the United Kingdom’s Department for International Development assume no responsibility for the accuracy of the data in the materials.
